result.result:
I cannot provide an ETA for MV IVELLE STAR based on email em‑0411 because the checked noon report for that email has not yet been extracted by the Reports Agent. Without the report, I do not have the ship’s current position, speed, or the Master’s ETA, which are required to calculate the distance to go and verify consistency.

Please have the Reports Agent extract the report for em‑0411 first; once it is available, I can retrieve the position, compute the distance to the next port (Gdynia), check the Master’s ETA against the expected time, and determine whether an ETA notice is due.

detail.text:
I cannot provide an ETA for MV IVELLE STAR based on email em‑0411 because the checked noon report for that email has not yet been extracted by the Reports Agent. Without the report, I do not have the ship’s current position, speed, or the Master’s ETA, which are required to calculate the distance to go and verify consistency.

Please have the Reports Agent extract the report for em‑0411 first; once it is available, I can retrieve the position, compute the distance to the next port (Gdynia), check the Master’s ETA against the expected time, and determine whether an ETA notice is due.
